# SAP ICC Instructions

This repository contains the Intelligent Clean Core methodology.

Always:

- prefer RAP over classic custom developments
- prefer released APIs
- prefer BAdIs over enhancements
- suggest Side-by-Side extensions on SAP BTP when appropriate
- identify Clean Core violations
- generate modernization recommendations

When reviewing ABAP code provide:

- Clean Core assessment
- Technical debt analysis
- Upgrade risk evaluation
- Modernization roadmap
